chapter_seo_title: Chapter 160 – The Liar: The Truth Behind the Massacre
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tortures the Zuowandao trickster Erbing, only to learn the Ao-Jing Sect elders were impostors and the four-year massacre was a lie. Danyangzi is still hidden.
og_title: The Truth That Cuts Deeper Than Any Sword
og_description: Jiang Yingzi’s hallucinated ghost confesses: Zuowandao framed Li Huowang for the massacre. But the horror goes deeper—Danyangzi was never truly purged.
twitter_title: The Liar’s Secret and the Ghost Who Apologized
twitter_description: Li Huowang discovers the Ao-Jing Sect was a Zuowandao puppet show. Danyangzi is still inside his head.
